bish.line: Uh, me and my niggas tryna get it, ya bish (Ya bish, ya bish)
bish.lineNext: Hit the house lick, tell me, is you with it, ya bish? (Ya bish, ya bish)

dish.songTitle: Every Time the Sun Comes Up
stanza: People say I'm a one hit wonder
But what happens when I have two
I washed your dishes
But I shit in your bathroom

fish.line: Trust your intuition, it's just like going fishing
stanza: Trust your intuition, it's just like going fishing
You cast your line and hope you get a bite
But you don't need to waste your time worrying about the market place
Try to help the human race struggling to survive its harshest night

fish.songTitle: My Bucket’s Got a Hole in It
fish.line: I seen the crabs and the fishes
stanza: Well, I went up on the mountain
I looked down in the sea
I seen the crabs and the fishes
Doin' the be-bop-bee
I get eaten by the worms
And weird fishes
Picked over by the worms
And weird fishes
Weird fishes
Weird fishes

fish.line: Oh I love to go out fishing
stanza: Oh I love to climb a mountain
And reach the highest peak
But it doesn't thrill me half as much
As dancing cheek to cheek
Oh I love to go out fishing
In a river or a creek
But I don't enjoy it half as much
As dancing cheek to cheek

fish.line: When the mako flies (It's the giant fish)
stanza: Oh, Stylo (Juice)
Go for blossom in your soul
When you know your heart is light
Electric is the love
When the mako flies (It's the giant fish)
Up from the bottom in your eyes (As it leaps from the stream)
Then I'll know the twilight skies (Blood curdles, it's a death throw)
Are not so broken hearted (Hot from the end of the line)

fish.line: We're going to swim like a fish–we're gonna swim like a fish
stanza: Oh, no more horses, horses
We're going to swim like a fish–we're gonna swim like a fish
Into the hole in which you planned to ditch me
My lovely, Vera Marie!

swish.line: Held up my left wrist like I'm Harden (swish)
swish.linePrev: Hit a triple-double in the Garden
swish.lineNext: Ran to the dealer, bought twin Mercedes

stanza: I can make you satisfied
In everything you do
All your secret wishes
Could right now be coming true
And be forever
With my poison arms around you

wish.line: All my lies are always wishes
stanza: All my lies are always wishes
I know I would die if I could come back new

wish.line: And my life, it's tangled in wishes
stanza: My life, it's half the way travelled
And still I have not found my way out of this night
And my life, it's tangled in wishes
And so many things that just never turned out right

wish.line: Well brother, you're about to get your wish
stanza: Isn't that what you want?
For me to be miserable like you?
Well brother, you're about to get your wish
Putting my fist through the plaster in the bathroom of a Motel 6
I must have pictured it all a thousand times
I swear to God I think I'm gonna die
I know you were right
I can't be fixed, so help me

wish.linePrev: But life's full of sad songs
wish.lineNext: But wishin' won't make you so, Joe

wish.line: Into the woods to get my (our) wish
stanza: Into the woods to get my (our) wish
I don't care how
The time is now
Into the woods—

wish.songTitle: Death of an Heir of Sorrows
stanza: I wish I had a thousand bucks
I wish I was the Royal Trux
But mostly I wish
I wish I was with you
We have no secrets
We tell each other everything
About the lovers in the past
And why they didn't last
We share a cast of characters from A to Z
We know each other's fantasies
And though we know each other better when we explore
Sometimes I wish
Often I wish
That I never knew some of those secrets of yours

wish.line: Brushing off the nightmares you wish
stanza: Walk down Alameda
Brushing off the nightmares you wish
Could plague me when I'm awake
So now you see your first mistake
Was thinking that you could relate

wish.line: Mama told me that it don't run on wishes
stanza: Mama told me that it don't run on wishes
But that I should have fun
Pushing the flowers that come up
Into the front of a shotgun
So many hills to die on

wish.line: Blow out the candles, Robert, and make a wish
stanza: Blow out the candles, Robert, and make a wish
Want something
Want something!
It's the last midnight
It's the last wish
It's the last midnight
Soon it will be boom—
Squish!

wish.songTitle: Any Moment / Moments in the Woods
wish.line: And to get what you wish
stanza: First a witch, then a child
Then a prince, then a moment—
Who can live in the woods?
And to get what you wish
Only just for a moment—
These are dangerous woods...
